units.locator: Article 56. Municipal charter
units.text: 3) the presence of corruption-generating factors in the charter or the municipal legal act amending or supplementing it.
units.label: Point 3 Part 7 Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. Municipal charter
units.text: 8. Refusal of state registration of a municipal charter or municipal legal act amending or supplementing it, and failure to comply with the established time limits for their state registration, may be challenged by citizens and local self-government bodies before the federal executive authority authorized in the field of registration of municipal charters and in court.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. Municipal charter
units.text: 9. The municipal charter and a municipal legal act amending or supplementing it must be officially published after their state registration and enter into force after official publication.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. Municipal charter
units.text: 10. The head of the municipality must publish the registered municipal charter or municipal legal act amending or supplementing it within seven days after receiving from the territorial body of the federal executive authority authorized in the field of registration of municipal charters the notice provided for in part 6 of Article 4 of Federal Law of 21.07.2005 No. 97-ФЗ “On State Registration of Municipal Charters”, confirming entry of information about the charter or the amending act in the state register of municipal charters of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. Municipal charter
units.text: 11. Amendments and additions to the municipal charter changing the structure of local self-government bodies or the division of powers among them (except changes bringing the charter into conformity with federal laws, and changes to the powers, terms of office or election (appointment) procedures of persons holding municipal offices) enter into force after the expiry of the term of office of the municipal representative body that adopted the municipal legal act making those amendments and additions, except in the cases established by this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. Municipal charter
units.text: 12. Amendments and additions to the municipal charter providing for the establishment of a municipal control and accounts body enter into force in accordance with the procedure provided for in part 9 of this Article.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. Municipal charter
units.text: 13. Amendments and additions to the municipal charter are made by a municipal legal act, which may take the form of:
units.label: Part 13 Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. Municipal charter
units.text: 1) a decision of the municipal representative body signed by its chair and the head of the municipality;
units.label: Point 1 Part 13 Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. Municipal charter
units.text: 2) a separate regulatory legal act adopted by the municipal representative body and signed by the head of the municipality. In this case, the act bears the identifying particulars of the representative body’s decision adopting it. Transitional provisions and/or rules on the entry into force of amendments and additions to the municipal charter may not be included in that decision of the representative body.
units.label: Point 2 Part 13 Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. Municipal charter
units.text: 14. The municipal charter is brought into conformity with a federal law or a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation within the time limit established by those legislative acts.
units.label: Part 14 Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. Municipal charter
units.text: 15. If a federal law or law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation does not establish the time limit referred to in part 14 of this Article, the period for bringing the municipal charter into conformity with that law is determined taking into account its entry-into-force date, the need to officially publish and discuss at public hearings the draft municipal legal act amending or supplementing the charter, consideration of citizens’ proposals on it, the frequency of municipal representative body meetings, and the periods for state registration and official publication of the act; as a rule, the period must not exceed six months.
units.label: Part 15 Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. Municipal charter
units.text: 16. A municipal charter may not be restated in a new version by adopting a municipal legal act amending or supplementing it. In such a case, a new municipal charter is adopted, and the previously effective charter and municipal legal acts amending or supplementing it are repealed from the date the new charter enters into force.
units.label: Part 16 Art. 56

units.locator: Article 57. Decisions adopted through citizens’ direct expression of will
units.text: Article 57. Decisions adopted through citizens’ direct expression of will
units.label: Art. 57

units.locator: Article 57. Decisions adopted through citizens’ direct expression of will
units.text: 1. Citizens of the municipality directly decide matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life through the municipality’s population expressing its will directly at a local referendum or citizens’ assembly.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 57

units.locator: Article 57. Decisions adopted through citizens’ direct expression of will
units.text: 2. If implementation of a decision adopted through the direct expression of the will of the population of a municipality additionally requires the adoption (issuance) of a municipal legal act, the local self-government body or local self-government official whose competence includes adoption (issuance) of that act shall, within 15 days from the entry into force of the decision adopted at a referendum or citizens’ assembly, set the time limit for preparing and/or adopting the corresponding municipal legal act. That time limit may not exceed three months.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 57

units.locator: Article 57. Decisions adopted through citizens’ direct expression of will
units.text: 3. Failure to meet the time limit for issuing a municipal legal act required to implement a decision adopted through the direct expression of the will of the population constitutes grounds for early termination of the powers of the head of the municipality, the head of the local administration or the representative body of the municipality.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 57

units.locator: Article 58. Rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality
units.text: Article 58. Rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality
units.label: Art. 58

units.locator: Article 58. Rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality
units.text: 1. The rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality shall be approved by the representative body of the corresponding municipality.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 58

units.locator: Article 58. Rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality
units.text: 2. The rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality regulate matters concerning:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 58

units.locator: Article 58. Rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality
units.text: 1) maintenance of public-use areas and the procedure for using such areas;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 58

units.locator: Article 58. Rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality
units.text: 2) the external appearance of facades and enclosing structures of buildings, structures and facilities;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 58

units.locator: Article 58. Rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality
units.text: 3) design, placement, maintenance and restoration of elements of territorial improvement and upkeep, including after earthworks;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 58

units.locator: Article 58. Rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality
units.text: 4) organization of lighting in the municipality, including architectural illumination of buildings, structures and facilities;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 58

units.locator: Article 58. Rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality
units.text: 5) organization of greening in the municipality, including the procedure for creating, maintaining, restoring and protecting lawns, flower beds and other areas occupied by herbaceous plants within the boundaries of settlements;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 58

units.locator: Article 58. Rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality
units.text: 6) placement of information in the municipality, including installation of street-name and house-number signs and signboards;
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 58

units.locator: Article 58. Rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality
units.text: 7) placement and maintenance of children’s playgrounds and sports grounds, animal-walking areas, parking areas (parking spaces) and small architectural forms;
units.label: Point 7 Part 2 Art. 58

units.locator: Article 58. Rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality
units.text: 8) organization of pedestrian routes, including sidewalks, avenues, walkways and paths;
units.label: Point 8 Part 2 Art. 58

units.locator: Article 58. Rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality
units.text: 9) development of the territory of the municipality to ensure unhindered movement within it by persons with disabilities and other population groups with limited mobility;
units.label: Point 9 Part 2 Art. 58

units.locator: Article 58. Rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality
units.text: 10) cleaning of the territory of the municipality, including in winter;
units.label: Point 10 Part 2 Art. 58

units.locator: Article 58. Rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality
units.text: 11) organization of stormwater drainage;
units.label: Point 11 Part 2 Art. 58

units.locator: Article 58. Rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality
units.text: 12) the procedure for carrying out earthworks;
units.label: Point 12 Part 2 Art. 58

units.locator: Article 58. Rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality
units.text: 13) participation, including financial participation, by owners and/or other lawful possessors of buildings, structures, facilities and land plots (except owners and/or other lawful possessors of premises in apartment buildings whose underlying land plots have not been formed or have been formed along the boundaries of those buildings) in the maintenance of adjoining areas;
units.label: Point 13 Part 2 Art. 58

units.locator: Article 58. Rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality
units.text: 14) determination of the boundaries of adjoining areas in accordance with the procedure established by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 14 Part 2 Art. 58

units.locator: Article 58. Rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality
units.text: 15) festive decoration of the territory of the municipality;
units.label: Point 15 Part 2 Art. 58

units.locator: Article 58. Rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality
units.text: 16) the procedure for participation by citizens and organizations in implementing measures for territorial improvement and upkeep in the municipality.
units.label: Point 16 Part 2 Art. 58

units.locator: Article 58. Rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality
units.text: 3. A law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation may provide for other matters regulated by the rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in a municipality, based on the natural and climatic, geographical, socioeconomic and other characteristics of individual municipalities.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 58

units.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality
units.label: Art. 59

units.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 1. Regulatory legal acts of the representative body of a municipality include:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 59

units.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 1) a regulatory legal act approving the charter of the municipality;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 59

units.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 2) a regulatory legal act approving the budget of the municipality;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 59

units.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 3) the rules for territorial improvement and upkeep in the municipality;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 59

units.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 4) regulatory legal acts approving agreements concluded between local self-government bodies;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 59

units.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 5) other regulatory legal acts adopted by the representative body of the municipality on matters assigned to its competence by federal laws, laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and the charter of the municipality.
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 59

units.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 2. On matters assigned to its competence by federal laws, laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and the charter of the municipality, the representative body of the municipality shall adopt:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 59

units.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 1) decisions establishing rules binding within the territory of the municipality;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 59

units.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 2) a decision on removal of the head of the municipality from office;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 59

units.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 3) decisions on the organization of the activities of the representative body of the municipality;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 59

units.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 4) decisions on other matters assigned to its competence by federal laws, laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and the charter of the municipality.
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 59

units.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 3. Draft regulatory legal acts of the representative body of a municipality on establishing, bringing into effect or terminating taxes (levies), changing tax rates (levy rates), the procedure and time limits for paying taxes (levies), establishing (abolishing) tax benefits (levy benefits) and/or the grounds and procedure for their application, and other draft regulatory legal acts of the representative body of the municipality providing for expenditure financed from the local budget shall be considered by the representative body of the municipality upon submission by the head of the local administration or where an opinion of that person is available. That opinion shall be submitted to the representative body of the municipality within the period established by the charter of the municipality, which may not be less than 20 days.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 59

units.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 4. Draft regulatory legal acts may be submitted to the representative body of a municipality by deputies of the representative body of the municipality, the head of the municipality, other local self-government bodies, the head of the local administration, territorial public self-government bodies, citizens’ initiative groups and other holders of the right of lawmaking initiative specified in the charter of the municipality, except in cases provided for by this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 59

units.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 5. The procedure for adoption of decisions by the representative body of a municipality shall be determined by the charter of the municipality. A decision of the representative body of a municipality, including a decision establishing rules binding within the territory of the municipality or on matters of organization of the representative body’s activities, may not be deemed adopted if fewer than half of the established number of deputies of the representative body of the municipality voted in its favour.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 59

units.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 6. The head of the municipality shall sign and make public a regulatory legal act adopted by the representative body of the municipality.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 59

units.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 7. A regulatory legal act adopted by the representative body of a municipality shall be forwarded to the head of the municipality for signature and making public within 10 days.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 59

units.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 8. The head of a municipality has the right to reject a regulatory legal act adopted by the representative body of the municipality. In that case, the regulatory legal act shall be returned to the representative body of the municipality within 10 days with a reasoned justification for its rejection or proposals for amendments and additions.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 59

units.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 9. A regulatory legal act rejected by the head of a municipality shall be reconsidered by the representative body of the municipality.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 59

units.locator: Article 59. Regulatory and other legal acts of the representative body of a municipality
units.text: 10. If, on reconsideration, the regulatory legal act is approved in its previously adopted wording by a majority of at least two thirds of the established number of deputies of the representative body of the municipality, it shall be signed by the head of the municipality within seven days and made public.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 59

units.locator: Article 60. Legal acts of the head of a municipality
units.text: Article 60. Legal acts of the head of a municipality
units.label: Art. 60

units.locator: Article 60. Legal acts of the head of a municipality
units.text: Within the powers established by the charter of the municipality and decisions of the representative body of the municipality, the head of the municipality shall issue resolutions and executive orders on matters assigned to the head’s competence by the charter of the municipality in accordance with this Federal Law and other federal laws, and also resolutions and executive orders of the local administration on the matters specified in part 2 of Article 61 of this Federal Law where the head of the municipality exercises the powers of the head of the local administration.
units.label: Art. 60 · text

units.locator: Article 61. Legal acts of local self-government officials
units.text: Article 61. Legal acts of local self-government officials
units.label: Art. 61

units.locator: Article 61. Legal acts of local self-government officials
units.text: 1. The chair of the representative body of a municipality shall issue resolutions and executive orders on the organization of the activities of the representative body of the municipality and sign decisions of the representative body of the municipality.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 61

units.locator: Article 61. Legal acts of local self-government officials
units.text: 2. Within the powers established by federal laws, laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, the charter of the municipality and regulatory legal acts of the representative body of the municipality, the head of the local administration shall issue resolutions of the local administration on matters of directly supporting the population’s daily life and matters connected with the exercise of individual state powers transferred to local self-government bodies by federal laws and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, and executive orders of the local administration on the organization of the work of the local administration.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 61

units.locator: Article 61. Legal acts of local self-government officials
units.text: 3. Other local self-government officials shall issue executive orders and administrative orders on matters assigned to their powers.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 61
